import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import time
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb

np.random.seed(42)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

X_train_text = train["comment_text"]
X_test_text = test["comment_text"]
test_ids = test["id"].values
y_train = train[target_cols].values

print("Performing train/val split (without stratification)...")
X_train_val, X_val_text, y_train_val, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_text, y_train, test_size=0.15, random_state=42
)

print(f"Training set size: {len(X_train_val)}")
print(f"Validation set size: {len(X_val_text)}")

print("Building TF-IDF vectors...")
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=8000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english", min_df=2
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_val)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)

print(f"TF-IDF feature count: {X_train_vec.shape[1]}")

# Adjust parameters based on class frequency for faster training
class_params = {
    "toxic": {
        "max_depth": -1,
        "n_estimators": 150,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "early_stopping": 20,
    },
    "severe_toxic": {
        "max_depth": -1,
        "n_estimators": 120,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "early_stopping": 20,
    },
    "obscene": {
        "max_depth": -1,
        "n_estimators": 150,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "early_stopping": 20,
    },
    "threat": {
        "max_depth": -1,
        "n_estimators": 100,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 30,
        "early_stopping": 15,
    },
    "insult": {
        "max_depth": -1,
        "n_estimators": 150,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "early_stopping": 20,
    },
    "identity_hate": {
        "max_depth": -1,
        "n_estimators": 60,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 50,
        "early_stopping": 15,
    },
}

models = []
valid_aucs = []
submission_preds = np.zeros((len(X_test_text), len(target_cols)))
start_time = time.time()

for i, target in enumerate(target_cols):
    y_train_col = y_train_val[:, i]
    y_val_col = y_val[:, i]

    class_rate = np.mean(y_train_col)
    params = class_params[target]

    n_estimators = params["n_estimators"]
    max_depth = params["max_depth"]
    min_data_in_leaf = params["min_data_in_leaf"]
    early_stopping_rounds = params["early_stopping"]

    print(
        f"\nTraining model for '{target}' (positive rate: {class_rate:.4f}, estimators: {n_estimators})..."
    )

    clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        objective="binary",
        metric="auc",
        verbose=-1,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        n_estimators=n_estimators,
        max_depth=max_depth,
        num_leaves=30,
        feature_fraction=0.8,
        bagging_fraction=0.8,
        bagging_freq=10,
        min_data_in_leaf=min_data_in_leaf,
        random_state=42,
    )

    clf.fit(
        X_train_vec,
        y_train_col,
        eval_set=[(X_val_vec, y_val_col)],
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(early_stopping_rounds, verbose=False),
            lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
        ],
    )

    y_pred_val = clf.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
    auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val_col, y_pred_val)
    valid_aucs.append(auc_score)
    print(f"Validation AUC ({target}): {auc_score:.4f}")

    submission_preds[:, i] = clf.predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1]
    models.append(clf)

    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    remaining = 5400 - elapsed  # 90 minutes total allowed, stay safe
    print(
        f"Elapsed time so far: {elapsed/60:.1f} minutes, remaining: {remaining/60:.1f} minutes"
    )

mean_auc = np.mean(valid_aucs)
print(f"\n=== Final Results ===")
print(f"Mean Column-wise ROC AUC on Validation Set: {mean_auc:.4f}")
print(f"Individual AUCs: {valid_aucs}")

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        **{col: submission_preds[:, i] for i, col in enumerate(target_cols)},
    }
)
submission_df = submission_df[["id"] + target_cols]
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
